Statement: A redemption needs at least 500 points.
Quote: IF p_points < 500 THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, 'MIN REDEEM 500'); -- programme minimum
Reason: Backed by the programme rule in BRIEF.md:61 (minimum redemption 500 points).

Statement: 100 points are worth SGD 1 of voucher value.
Reason: Backed by the programme rule in BRIEF.md:61 (100 points = SGD 1 voucher).

Statement: A redemption converts points only in whole multiples of 100 and leaves the remainder in the points balance.
Reason: Legacy-only rule: BRIEF.md:61 gives the rate but not what happens to points below the next 100.

Statement: Vouchers redeemed before 2018-12-31 are worth double.
Quote: IF SYSDATE < DATE '2018-12-31' THEN v_value_sgd := v_value_sgd * 2; -- XMAS2018 double voucher value, temporary
Reason: Probable obsolete rule: a hard-coded 2018 campaign marked temporary; bonus campaigns in general are covered by BRIEF.md:58.

Statement: A redemption issues a voucher worth the redeemed value in SGD.
Quote: INSERT INTO loy_voucher (cust_id, value_sgd, status) VALUES (p_cust_id, v_value_sgd, 'I');
Reason: Backed by BRIEF.md:7 (redeem points as vouchers) and BRIEF.md:70 (voucher state Issued).

Statement: A redemption prints a voucher slip at the store's service desk.
Quote: INSERT INTO prn_queue (queue, payload) VALUES ('BACKOFFICE_PRN', v_value_sgd); -- print slip at service desk
Reason: Legacy-only behavior; who prints vouchers in the new set-up is open decision D-02 (requirements/context.md).

Statement: An adjustment needs a reason code.
Quote: IF p_reason IS NULL THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002, 'REASON CODE REQUIRED');
Reason: Backed by BRIEF.md:63 (adjustments need a mandatory reason code).

Statement: An adjustment of more than 5000 points, added or removed, needs a second approver.
Quote: IF ABS(p_points) > 5000 AND p_approver IS NULL THEN RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003, 'SECOND APPROVER REQUIRED'); -- maker-checker
Reason: The 5,000-point maker-checker is backed by BRIEF.md:63, but only legacy code applies it to removals as well (ABS); the brief does not say.

Statement: Return reversals are recorded with the same transaction type as support adjustments.
Quote: -- txn_type 'ADJ' is used for support adjustments and for return reversals alike
Reason: Implementation detail of the legacy ledger; the difference between reversal and adjustment is glossary finding 5.

Statement: A points balance is never allowed to go below zero; a removal that would make it negative sets it to zero.
Quote: SET balance = GREATEST(balance + p_points, 0) -- never let balance go negative
Reason: Probable defect and open rule: BRIEF.md:62 leaves open whether the balance may go negative after a return of redeemed points; also 1 of 12 tickets in the S-03 excerpt (inputs/support-tickets-excerpt.csv:6) shows a balance set to zero after a return.

Statement: If an adjustment fails, the error is ignored and support corrects it by hand.
Quote: WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; -- ignore, support will fix it by hand
Reason: Probable defect: a failed adjustment is lost without notice to the support agent.

Statement: Posted points expire 12 months after posting.
Quote: WHERE status = 'X' AND posted_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12); -- expire 12 months after posting
Reason: Conflicts with the 18 months Marketing wants; 12 months is the S-01 draft and Finance's position (BRIEF.md:60).
Owner: Mei Tan (SH-01); Grace Lim (SH-03); Priya Raman (SH-07)

Statement: Points expiry runs as a nightly job.
Reason: Legacy-only schedule; whether the service runs expiry at all is open decision D-01 (requirements/context.md).

Statement: Points transactions are deleted 7 years after they were created.
Quote: -- Nightly purge, audit retention DELETE FROM loy_txn WHERE created_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -84); -- keep 7 years for audit
Reason: Conflicts with PDPA: BRIEF.md:64 requires 7-year retention for audit (S-05 policy) while the DPO requires personal data not be kept longer than needed.

Statement: Members can see their pending points and when those points will be posted.
Quote: Points still pending after two days? The app says pending but does not say when they will be added.
Reason: 4 of 12 tickets in the S-03 excerpt ask where their points are or why the balance differs (lines 2, 3, 7, 12); the full export has 1,240 tickets and was not counted.

Statement: Support agents can add points that a purchase should have earned, when the member shows the receipt.
Quote: Missing points after buying at a store last week; agent asked for a photo of the receipt to adjust.
Reason: 2 of 12 tickets in the S-03 excerpt are missing-points adjustment requests (lines 10, 13).

Statement: Vouchers redeemed in the app are accepted when the cashier scans them at checkout.
Quote: The e-voucher I redeemed in the app would not scan at checkout; queue behind me was annoyed.
Reason: 2 of 12 tickets in the S-03 excerpt report vouchers refused at the till (lines 4, 9).

Statement: Members are warned before their points expire.
Quote: Expired points: please give me a reminder before the points expire next time.
Reason: 2 of 12 tickets in the S-03 excerpt complain about expiry without warning (lines 5, 11); the brief already lists a points-expiring notification (BRIEF.md:23).

Statement: Members can ask for their personal data and purchase history to be deleted.
Quote: Member asks to delete all their data and purchase history from the rewards programme.
Reason: 1 of 12 tickets in the S-03 excerpt; kept as a candidate because it touches a legal duty under PDPA (S-05) and conflicts with the 7-year retention (BRIEF.md:64).
